en: Sepia-toned image showing an old stone fortification with thick defensive walls and a dry moat or ditch curving along the right side. The walls are made of rough-cut stone blocks, with the far wall containing small rectangular openings resembling embrasures. Vegetation and scrubby grass grow on and around the ramparts, giving the site a slightly overgrown, ruin-like appearance. A dirt path follows the base of the inner wall, leading to a small arched gateway at the far right. In the distance appears a flat horizon, possibly a shoreline or open plain. There is no visible text on the front of the image.
